reading.text:
Reading of def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Constants.mk.

Paper notion. As in the reading of Constants: the constructor of the parameter record
(T, L, ||G||, c_G, alpha, beta_1, beta_2, possibly c_BDG, and possibly the constraints of
Assumptions 2.3-2.5). Faithful iff its fields are exactly those of the record and the record is
as described there: no dimension, no nu, no coefficients; constraints (if any) exactly the
paper's.

comparison.text:
def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Constants.mk: the constructor of the Prop-structure Constants n m α
β₁ β₂ from the seven hypotheses 0 ≤ α, 0 ≤ β₁, 0 ≤ β₂, 0 < α + β₁, 0 < β₁ + β₂,
(m < n → 0 < β₁), (n < m → 0 < α ∧ 0 < β₂). These are exactly Assumption 2.5's constant
constraints (see the Constants comparison); my reading's "parameter record" alternative does not
apply, and its condition "constraints exactly the paper's" holds. Verdict: faithful.
